description: readiness rc.7 pass 5 F-18: a value produced by a mapping satisfies Section 2.1 and the schema itself. timeout_ms 1e22 is a valid literal, but it maps to limit.seconds 1e19, an integer between 2^53 and 10^21 that the canonical form writes as 10000000000000000000, which Section 2.1 refuses: code 2 at /guardrails/timeout_ms. Before the fix the document was valid and its canonical form invalid.
